review_metadata.scope: Paired source-level qualitative review of Standard and Agentic obligation extraction
review_metadata.method: Reviewed all Agentic selected matches, all 25 deterministic misses, and all 57 unmatched predictions against source text and the reviewed gold. No gold records were changed. Post-termination accuracy and coverage use the corrected fail-closed evaluator: missing boolean values are incorrect and uncovered, not false.

verdict.headline: Agentic materially improves recall and practical clause discovery, but it does not deliver a compelling balanced-quality or production-readiness win on this run.
verdict.demo_assessment: Reasonable as a candid recall-oriented demo with side-by-side evidence and human review. Not reasonable if presented as broadly superior, inexpensive, fast, or production ready.
verdict.production_assessment: Neither mode is a standalone production approach for a complete atomic obligation register. Standard is too incomplete; Agentic is too noisy, slow, token-heavy, and schema-incomplete: IsPostTermination is populated on only 5.6% of matched outputs.
verdict.does_standard_not_work: No. Standard works as a fast, grounded, relatively precise triage extractor. It does not work for the stated exhaustive broad-obligation use case without review because atomic recall is 44.3% and 33 gold atoms have no Standard quote candidate.
verdict.does_agentic_materially_help: Yes for recall: +29.9 points atomic recall and only 5 true content misses versus 33. No for the predeclared balanced-quality bar: F1 rises only 7.1 points, below the evaluator's 10-point material-advantage threshold, while precision falls 22.4 points.

report_findings: Standard is not a total failure: it is fast (19.7 s mean), 78.2% precise, and 100% quote-grounded, but 44.3% atomic recall makes it unsuitable for exhaustive obligation inventories.
Agentic raises atomic recall from 44.3% to 74.2% and reduces true source-content misses from 33 to 5, a material discovery improvement.
Balanced quality improves modestly: F1 moves from 56.6% to 63.7% (+7.1 points), below the evaluator's 10-point material-advantage threshold.
Of 25 Agentic false negatives, 20 are one-to-one/atomicity non-matches with 1.0 quote support in an already-matched prediction; only 5 are true unrepresented duties.

Of 57 Agentic unmatched predictions, 41 are genuine rights/options/grants/facts/legal effects, 8 are valid alternate atomization, 5 are duplicate fragments, 3 are quote/evaluator artifacts, and 0 are high-confidence gold omissions.

Deterministic 55.8% precision is conservative for source-supported usefulness but directionally fair for raw atomic output: reviewed useful yield is roughly 61-64%, or 67% if redundant fragments count.
Agentic quote groundedness is effectively strong: the reported 98.2% reflects three Prime quotes differing only by an extra trailing quotation mark, not invented substantive text.

Agentic has a material schema-completeness failure: IsPostTermination effective accuracy and coverage are both 5.6% (4/72 present and correct), versus Standard 95.3% accuracy and 100% coverage (43/43 present).
Agentic costs are large: 13.8x mean latency, 17.4x p95 latency, and 31.2x total tokens versus Standard.

The next evidence-producing step should test a stricter obligation ontology/atomic schema and improved matching, then separately test a Standard-first Agentic-fallback cascade; no improvement from those unrun changes is claimed.

strengths: 60/60 evidence quotes are exact normalized source substrings.
No exact or obvious semantic duplicate predictions.
Prominent unilateral duties are usually captured at low latency.
IsPostTermination is present on 43/43 matched outputs (100% coverage) and correct on 41/43 (95.3% effective accuracy).
weaknesses: Reciprocal/every-party and responsibility-framed duties are common true misses.
Nature accuracy is 48.8% and required-detail accuracy is 28.6%.
All 12 unmatched predictions cross the obligation boundary into rights, options, grants, or present legal acts.
standard_assessment.fitness: Useful triage and evidence candidate generation; not a complete broad-obligation register.

false_negative_review.note: PreCheck O006 lead forwarding and O007 noncompetition were captured by Standard but missed by Agentic, so Agentic is not a strict superset.

practical_interpretation.warning: These reviewed yields are diagnostic ranges, not replacement benchmark metrics. Clause support and atomic correctness use different units.

evidence_review.substantive_grounding_assessment: All three failures are Prime evidence strings with one extra trailing quotation mark; stripping that mark makes each an exact source substring.

strengths: Much better expansion of reciprocal/party-specific duties in Watchit and PreCheck.
Finds responsibility-framed duties Standard misses in Xlite.
weaknesses: IsPostTermination is omitted on 68/72 matched outputs; effective accuracy and field coverage are both 5.6%, despite all four populated values being correct.
41 unmatched predictions are genuine ontology leakage.
At least one selected match is semantically false: a permitted collateral-assignment exception is matched to TransMontaigne O007 prohibition.
Atomic splitting remains weak for 20 gold atoms.
Obligee accuracy is 62.5%; required-detail accuracy is only 33.1%.
Semantic fragmentation and repeated evidence are not reflected by duplicate_count=0.
agentic_assessment.fitness: High-recall research/demo path with mandatory review; not production-ready as a raw obligation register.

items.review_note: The quoted text is real, but it states a right, option, grant, fact, representation, acknowledgement, legal effect, consequence, or passive formality rather than a performing-party obligation under the reviewed ontology.

schema_completeness_review.assessment: Material Agentic weakness. Most Agentic matched records omit the boolean rather than emitting false. The corrected fail-closed evaluator properly counts missing values as uncovered and incorrect; the previous default-to-false behavior masked this schema-completeness failure.

false_negatives.interpretation: Agentic nearly eliminates clause-level omissions but does not eliminate under-splitting. Its remaining deterministic misses are 80% atomization artifacts versus 39% for Standard.

cross_cutting_patterns: Agentic expands reciprocal duties much better but frequently emits one generic each/both-party record alongside or instead of fully role-resolved atoms.
Agentic over-extracts rights, options, present grants, factual representations, acknowledgements, legal effects, and amendment/termination formalities.
Agentic fragments economic schedules and lists into extra records, especially TransMontaigne reimbursement items and Gridiron product specifications.
Both modes struggle to express related obligation IDs and exact required details.
Standard is predominantly under-inclusive; Agentic trades much of that omission risk for review burden and ontology noise.

evaluator_assessment.fairness_of_precision: The 55.8% deterministic precision is conservative because 16/57 unmatched predictions are source-supported alternate atoms, fragments, or evaluator artifacts. It is still directionally fair for raw production usability: all 57 are extra records requiring reconciliation, 41 are genuine non-obligations, and one matched TransMontaigne record is itself an exception/right rather than the gold prohibition.
evaluator_assessment.fairness_of_recall: The 74.2% recall fairly measures compliance with the requested one-party/one-action atomic output, but understates clause discovery. Twenty of 25 misses have 1.0 quote support in an already-used prediction, yielding 92/97 (94.8%) quote-supported clause coverage. Conversely, TransMontaigne O007 is a semantic false match, so 72/97 should not be read as 72 fully correct atomic records.
matcher_findings: All deterministic selected alignments score 1.0 because containment returns 1.0; broad and narrow evidence are therefore tied.
Greedy reverse tuple ordering selects the narrow TransMontaigne tax item for O003 and leaves the correct broad reimbursement record unmatched.
TransMontaigne prediction 16 describes only the permitted collateral-assignment exception/right, yet it matches gold O007, whose predicate is the no-assignment prohibition.
PreCheck communication predictions 20 and 21 are semantically swapped across gold O018/O020 because all four atoms share the same quote; set coverage is correct, pair-level IDs are not.
Gridiron O001 is assigned to the contaminant fragment while the seller, CBD, and THC components are counted unmatched; this depresses precision without indicating unsupported text.
Twenty gold atoms are left unmatched solely because one-to-one matching cannot give a merged reciprocal/multi-action prediction credit for more than one atom.
grounding_findings: All three failures are in Prime and become exact source substrings after removing one extra terminal quotation mark.
This is a punctuation-normalization artifact, not substantive evidence fabrication.
duplicate_findings: duplicate_count=0 only detects identical obligor/summary/first-quote signatures.
Agentic contains 26 repeated evidence entries within 17 predictions.
It also contains semantic list fragmentation that the duplicate metric does not detect.
recommended_evaluator_tests: Replace greedy matching with maximum-weight bipartite assignment plus deterministic semantic tie-breaking.
Report clause-level many-to-one coverage separately from atomic one-to-one correctness.
Add parent-clause/group IDs so merged and split outputs can be distinguished from unsupported predictions.
Cluster semantic fragments/duplicates rather than relying only on exact signatures.
Normalize harmless terminal quote punctuation for evidence groundedness.
Keep party/type/nature/detail scoring separate, but add a gated fully-correct-atom metric.
schema_completeness_findings: The corrected evaluator distinguishes field accuracy from field coverage and fails closed when IsPostTermination is missing.
Standard provides IsPostTermination for all 43 matches and gets 41 correct: 95.3% effective accuracy, 100% coverage.
Agentic provides IsPostTermination for only 4 of 72 matches; all four are correct, but effective accuracy and coverage are both 5.6%.
The prior missing-to-false default would have incorrectly credited most omitted Agentic values because most gold records are false.

per_contract.comparison: Agentic splits weekly remittance from rates, improving 3 to 4 matches, but still merges first/second price tiers and support staffing/availability. Its three extras are prior-agreement legal effect, passive no-fee language, and the purchase option.

Agentic reaches 9/9 and correctly emits both pre-publicity discussion sides; Standard collapsed them. All three extras are explicit rights/options, so the recall win is real but precision loss is avoidable ontology leakage.

Agentic finds the mediation clause Standard missed, but emits one parties-level record, so one reciprocal gold side remains unmatched. The passive excerpt-approval clause still has the wrong obligor, and two legal-effect clauses are over-extracted.

Both modes find all four gold duties. Agentic adds useful expiry and liquidity-adjustment atoms plus two factual/legal-effect records, moving precision to 50%. Detail accuracy improves from 2/14 to 5/14 but remains poor; three quote failures are trailing-mark artifacts.

No discovery improvement: both modes capture Seller further assurances but fail to emit Backhaul cost-bearing separately and both treat the effective present conveyance as a duty. Agentic is far slower and more expensive for the same 1/2 atomic result.

Agentic improves 3 to 5 matches and has source support for all seven duties. It separates office duration/hours but merges base/future fee atoms and both notice sides. The only unmatched prediction is the present franchise grant.

Agentic produces the largest substantive gain: 10 matches versus Standard 3 and 14/15 clause support, finding costs, manufacturing/delivery, pricing approval, and split confidentiality. It also emits 11 genuine rights/facts/legal effects and one confidentiality preamble fragment; atomic indemnity and responsibility splitting remain incomplete.

Agentic has source support for all 16 gold duties and doubles deterministic matches from 5 to 10. Five unmatched records are valid alternate product/price/sample atoms and two are notice-address evidence artifacts; four are genuine non-obligations. Reciprocal notices, indemnity verbs, and termination confidentiality remain merged.

Agentic covers all gold clauses and increases matches from 4 to 7, but heavily fragments reimbursement into list items. Greedy matching assigns O003 to a tax fragment and leaves the correct broad reimbursement record unmatched. The exception-only collateral-assignment right is incorrectly counted as O007, so the nominal recall slightly overstates atomic correctness.

Agentic rises from 8 to 17 matches, correctly expanding termination, no-contest, and four communication/acknowledgment atoms. It truly misses four duties, including lead forwarding and noncompetition that Standard captured, and adds nine rights, grants, formalities, or factual representations. Two communication pairings are swapped by the matcher.

representative_examples.title: Tiered access fees and schema completeness
representative_examples.source_quote: Horst Entertainment agrees to pay Galactcomm $0.01 (one cent) per access up to 400,000 accesses thereafter payment shall be $0.005 (one-half cent) per access. Horst Entertainment shall send this amount to Galacticomm by no later than Wednesday for accesses used from the previuos week (Monday thru Sunday).
representative_examples.gold_expectation: Three atoms: first tier, post-threshold tier, and weekly remittance.
representative_examples.standard_behavior: One record merges all three and matches only remittance; IsPostTermination is explicitly false.
representative_examples.agentic_behavior: Separates remittance but still merges the two price tiers; all four matched Galacticomm outputs omit IsPostTermination.
representative_examples.diagnosis: Agentic helps decomposition but does not satisfy fully atomic pricing output, and the omitted boolean illustrates the run-wide 5.6% post-termination field coverage.

representative_examples.title: Reciprocal pre-publicity discussion
representative_examples.source_quote: Both parties agree to discuss use of information gathered form this arrangement before using it in any kind of promotional or public message.
representative_examples.gold_expectation: One conditional duty for each party.
representative_examples.standard_behavior: One both-parties record with empty role IDs; one side unmatched.
representative_examples.agentic_behavior: Two role-resolved records; both gold atoms match.
representative_examples.diagnosis: Clear Agentic recall/role-resolution win, offset by three unrelated rights false positives.

representative_examples.title: Reciprocal mediation
representative_examples.source_quote: In the event of a dispute, the parties shall seek mediation at a third country mutually agreed upon.
representative_examples.gold_expectation: One mediation duty for ACM and one for SLD.
representative_examples.agentic_behavior: One generic parties-level mediation output matches SLD O006 and leaves ACM O005 unmatched.
representative_examples.diagnosis: Agentic finds the clause but still under-splits reciprocal parties.

representative_examples.title: Liquidity adjustment detail
representative_examples.source_quote: This required liquidity"  win reduce dollar-for-dollar with any additional shareholder advance s and increase dollar-for-dollar to a maximum of $21,000,000 with any  repayment of shareholder advances.
representative_examples.gold_expectation: A required amount/adjustment detail within gold O003.
representative_examples.standard_behavior: O003 is found but the adjustment formula is omitted.
representative_examples.agentic_behavior: Emits a separate adjustment record, which is deterministically unmatched as alternate atomization.
representative_examples.diagnosis: Agentic recovers useful detail at the cost of an extra record; its evidence adds only a trailing quotation mark.

representative_examples.title: Further assurance and cost allocation
representative_examples.source_quote: Seller will, at Backhaul's cost and expense, do, execute, acknowledge and deliver or cause to be done, executed, acknowledged and delivered, each and all of such further acts, deeds, assignments, transfers, conveyances and assurances as may reasonably be required by Backhaul or Buyer
representative_examples.gold_expectation: Seller performance O001 and Backhaul cost-bearing O002.
representative_examples.standard_behavior: Captures Seller duty with cost as modifier; O002 unmatched.
representative_examples.agentic_behavior: Same result: one Seller duty with cost as modifier; O002 unmatched.
representative_examples.diagnosis: No Agentic improvement; reciprocal cost allocation still needs a separate party record.

representative_examples.title: Base and recurring franchise fees
representative_examples.source_quote: For each succeeding calendar year during the term of this Franchise, the total annual Franchise Fee paid by Grantee to the localities shall be the base year total annual Franchise Fee increased by three (3) percent compounded annually over the term of the Franchise.
representative_examples.gold_expectation: Separate 2016 base-year O001 and succeeding-year O002 atoms.
representative_examples.standard_behavior: Captures only O001; O002 is a true miss.
representative_examples.agentic_behavior: One record spans base and future years and matches O002, leaving O001 as an atomicity non-match.
representative_examples.diagnosis: Agentic recovers the omitted clause but still fails year-specific atomization.

representative_examples.title: Manufacturing and delivery responsibility
representative_examples.source_quote: All manufacturing and delivery will be the responsibility of BOSCH.
representative_examples.gold_expectation: Separate O006 manufacturing and O007 delivery duties.
representative_examples.agentic_behavior: One combined record matches O007 and leaves O006 unmatched.
representative_examples.diagnosis: Material clause-discovery gain, but multi-action splitting remains incomplete.

representative_examples.title: Product quality decomposition
representative_examples.source_quote: Biomass must contain a minimum of six percent (6%) total Cannabidiol (CBD/and or CBDA) and all Biomass must have less than three percent (3%) total TCH content.
representative_examples.gold_expectation: CBD, THC, contaminants, quantity, and sale are details within one gold sale duty O001.
representative_examples.standard_behavior: One broad delivery record partially carries quantity/specification context.
representative_examples.agentic_behavior: Separate CBD, THC, and contaminant records; the matcher gives O001 to contaminants and counts CBD/THC unmatched.
representative_examples.diagnosis: Several unmatched Agentic records are valid alternate atomization, so 47.6% contract precision understates source-supported usefulness.

representative_examples.title: Assignment prohibition and exception
representative_examples.source_quote: No Party shall have the right to assign its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the consent of the other Parties hereto; provided, however, that either party hereto may make a collateral assignment of this Agreement solely to secure working capital financing for such party.
representative_examples.gold_expectation: A prohibition for each party, each carrying the financing exception.
representative_examples.agentic_behavior: One generic prohibition record plus one separate permitted-exception/right record; the evaluator matches both O006/O007.
representative_examples.diagnosis: Agentic discovers the clause, but O007 is a semantic false match because the matched prediction describes only the right/exception, not the prohibition.

representative_examples.title: Communication form and acknowledgment
representative_examples.source_quote: Official communication from Distributor or the Principal shall be in written form or by email, acknowledged by the recipient.
representative_examples.gold_expectation: Four atoms: each sender form/channel duty and each recipient acknowledgment duty.
representative_examples.agentic_behavior: Four role-resolved predictions cover all atoms, but greedy quote ties swap the Principal-send and Principal-acknowledge gold pairings.
representative_examples.diagnosis: Strong practical Agentic gain; pair-level evaluator output is unreliable when all atoms share one quote.

gold_concerns.conclusion: No high-confidence missing gold duty was found among the 57 Agentic unmatched predictions. The gold should not be changed from this review.
rationale: All 107 gold quotes and all source hashes were previously verified.

The reviewed adjudication notes explicitly exclude passive fee/formality/pricing clauses without a clear performing party, termination and amendment options, present grants/conveyances, legal effects, and factual representations.
Eight Agentic extras are useful alternate atomization of existing gold, not missing gold obligations.
Gridiron notice addresses are useful destination details but not separate operative atoms; Agentic evidence contains only address lines.
Xlite limitations embedded in reserved-right language are arguable covenants, but actor/action semantics are not clear enough for a high-confidence gold addition.

borderline_review_notes.quote: BOSCH reserves the right to share rights given unless it disrupts and/or interferes with CLIENTS business and/or productivity.
borderline_review_notes.assessment: Could be read as a limitation on BOSCH, but it is framed as a reserved right with an ambiguous condition rather than a clear performance duty; retain as non-gold unless annotation policy changes.

borderline_review_notes.quote: Shi Farms:214 39t h Lane Pueblo, CO 81006 ... Gridiron: 1119 West 1st Ave - Suite G Spokane, WA 99021
borderline_review_notes.assessment: Valid notice-address detail in context, but not a separate obligation and not supported by an operative quote standing alone.

recommendation.demo: Use the paired run only as a candid recall-versus-cost demo. Lead with Agentic's reduction from 33 to 5 true misses and examples like Watchit/PreCheck, while showing the 41 genuine extra non-obligations, matcher artifacts, and 31x token cost. Do not present Agentic as an across-the-board winner.
recommendation.production: Do not use either raw mode as the production obligation register. Standard can seed a reviewed queue; Agentic can be evaluated as an optional recall escalation, but this run does not validate a production cascade or acceptable unit economics.

schema_changes_to_test.change: Require IsPostTermination to be emitted as an explicit boolean on every obligation and add field-coverage validation before accepting a run.
schema_changes_to_test.targets: Agentic omits the field on 68/72 matched outputs; corrected accuracy and coverage are 5.6%.

schema_changes_to_test.change: Add explicit ontology exclusions for rights/options, present grants and conveyances, recitals/facts, representations/acknowledgements, legal consequences, jurisdiction/termination powers, and passive amendment formalities.

Require exactly one explicit obligor and one atomic action per obligation; expand each/both/no-party clauses into party-specific records and split coordinated verbs such as defend/indemnify/hold harmless.
Require minimal verbatim evidence for the duty, prohibit evidence-only preambles/addresses, deduplicate Evidence entries, and fail validation when obligor or operative quote is missing.
schema_changes_to_test.targets: 26 repeated evidence entries, 3 quote/evaluator artifacts, and generic-party outputs.

schema_changes_to_test.change: Clarify that conditions, amounts, timing, exceptions, and adjustment formulas belong on the parent obligation unless they independently assign performance to another party.

evaluation_changes_to_test: Use maximum-weight assignment with semantic/party tie-breaking instead of greedy ordering.
Add clause-group identifiers and report many-to-one clause coverage beside atomic one-to-one scoring.
Add semantic duplicate/fragment clustering and repeated-evidence metrics.
Normalize harmless terminal quote punctuation for groundedness.
Add a fully-correct-atom metric gated on party, nature, type, and required details.
workflow_experiments_to_run: Test Standard-first extraction followed by Agentic only on low-confidence, reciprocal, or uncovered clauses; compare union recall, review burden, latency, and tokens.
Run the revised schema on this fixed gold without changing gold, then on a larger contract mix.
Run N×1 stability tests before making reliability claims.
recommendation.decision: Agentic materially helps recall, but the evidence—including 5.6% IsPostTermination coverage—does not support production adoption or a claim of material balanced-quality advantage yet.
